description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。**ClientToken**只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The value of **ClientToken** can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: SourceType=UPLOAD 时必传，标识待上传 Skill 压缩包的 OSS 地址
description.en: Required when SourceType is set to UPLOAD. The OSS URL of the skill package to upload.
The ID of the skill to update.

description.zh: SourceType=COPY 时必传，标识公共 Skill ID
description.en: Required when SourceType is set to COPY. The ID of the public skill.

description.zh: 更新 Skill 时的更新来源类型
description.en: The source type for updating the skill.

descriptions.zh:
### 前提条件
请先确认服务商在创建服务时开启变配功能并完成变配参数设置。
descriptions.en:
### Before you begin
Make sure that the service provider has enabled the specification change feature and configured the specification change parameters when creating the service.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenest update-skill --skill-id s-xxxxx --source-type COPY --source-skill-id s-xxxxx --oss-url https://embedding-pic.oss-cn-beijing-internal.aliyuncs.com/skill-creator1.zip --skill-description Create_new_skills. --skill-name skill-creator --skill-display-name example-string --skill-labels category:frontend-development --client-token 123e4567-e89b-12d3-a456-426655440000 --region cn-hangzhou
